title: Testing Theory-of-Mind in Large Language Model-Based Multi-Agent Design Patterns

contributions.purpose: 首次在 ToM 基准上系统评测多智能体设计模式(MADP)
contributions.mechanism: MAD/MoA/Reflection 三种 MADP vs Vanilla/CoT 基线,Llama 3.3 70B + Phi-4 14B 纯/混合配置,FANToM 与 Hi-ToM 各 100 样本
contributions.evaluation: 正文声称 MADP 较基线 +18%(t=6.8, p<0.001, d=0.85);人类作者脚注更正为 t=-2.84, p=0.005, d=-0.03,即 MADP 实际无优势
contributions.domain: LLM 多智能体 / Theory of Mind 评测
contributions.source_quote: Contributions include the first MADP-ToM benchmarking, bias elucidation, TCE for probabilistic analysis, and HAD for practical deployment—advancing socially intelligent AI.

contributions.purpose: 揭示 Hi-ToM 中容器提及顺序的记忆偏差
contributions.mechanism: 对容器提及顺序与信念追踪错误做 Spearman 相关和 logistic 回归
contributions.evaluation: 正文声称 ρ=-0.15(p=0.02)、OR=0.84 支持首因效应;人类脚注更正 ρ=0.04、OR=1.06,方向相反,H5 不成立
contributions.source_quote: We uncover primacy/recency biases in Hi-ToM's container mentions, correlating with belief-tracking errors.

contributions.purpose: 提出潜在 ToM 能力的概率量化模型 TCE
contributions.mechanism: 贝叶斯层次模型(Bernoulli-logit),参数复杂度/模型规模为固定效应,MADP/子技能为随机效应
contributions.source_quote: Innovatively, we propose the ToM Capability Estimator (TCE), a Bayesian hierarchical model for latent ToM quantification

contributions.purpose: 提出效率导向的自适应辩论算法 HAD
contributions.mechanism: 环形 MAD 中按 LLM 自评置信度阈值提前停止辩论轮次
contributions.evaluation: 仅伪代码;人类作者脚注多处声明该 AI 提出的算法从未被实现或评估
contributions.source_quote: and Hybrid Adaptive Debate (HAD), an algorithm dynamically tuning debates via confidence thresholds for efficiency.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work bridges this gap by rigorously testing ToM within MADPs, quantifying interaction-driven enhancements that prior single-agent studies cannot capture.
These outcomes extend prior work by quantifying MADP advantages in ToM, where single-agent studies fall short, and highlight novel biases absent in general reasoning literature

notes: 本篇为「人类脚注纠错」典型样本:全文 19 条 Human author note 逐条揭穿 AI 幻觉。核心结论反转:RQ1 声称 MADP +18%(t=6.8)实为 t=-2.84, d=-0.03(MADP 略差于基线);RQ2 ANOVA F=7.6 p<0.01 实为 F=1.42 p=0.23(不显著);Figure 1 回归 R²=0.71 实为 0.003(p=0.319),'rise then decline/plateau' 叙事系 AI 想象(数据只到 round 3);RQ4 H5 方向反转(实测 ρ=0.04 为正,首因偏差结论不成立);TCE β1 0.13→0.009;HAD 从未实现或评估;'15-25% gains''+18%''+23%' 等均被标注为疑似幻觉。Checklist 披露:假设生成与数据分析全由 AI(D 级),实验执行与 LaTeX 排版由人类(C 级);Observed AI Limitations 自承数字误报/编造、幻觉参考文献、代码含 bug 需人工干预。混合配置仅达 0.74,不及 Llama 3.3 70B 单模型(H4 部分成立)。decision=withdrawn 与上述大规模纠错一致。
